item.title: [ 5 Maps ] City of the Dead Redux (L4D2 Version)
item.description:
View ArticleSteam Workshop
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
City of the Dead Redux is a remake of City of the Dead originally released back in 2016, from the ground up. It incorporates the same general ideas of the original, while improving upon them. The Survivors must make their way through an abandoned city and end up in a mall, eager to escape they climb to the rooftop for a potential evacuation. You can get the Workshop Version by clicking here. The rooftop finale from the original City of the Dead is available in this as a bonus Survival map. Gamemode Support: Campaign: 5 Maps Versus: 5 Maps Survival: 4 Maps Scavenge: 1 Map Console Map Names: Apartments - cotd01_apartments_redux Streets - cotd02_streets_redux Sewers - cotd03_sewers_redux Mall - cotd04_mall_redux Rooftop Escape - cotd05_rooftop_redux Bonus Survival Map: cotd06_rooftopsurvival_redux Credits: KingDavid213 - Mapper, Level Design Loading... - Playtesting QueenAmethyst - Playtesting, Suggestions, Custom Graffiti Bianca - Early Testing TimelordMagnums357 - NAV help
